slices.focus: Ariana wins board approval for a part-time community-access coordinator shared with programming
slices.summary: Ariana presents tracking numbers and listening-event evidence to the board, winning approval for a part-time community-access coordinator role. She plans a tight role scope, a handoff list of tasks to stop doing, and a reporting structure that keeps archive work visible.
open_loops: Drafting a tight role scope before the position description hardens
Creating a not-doing list of evening tasks that should transfer to the new role
Preparing a one-page hiring note preserving the role's archival logic
decisions: Ariana won board approval for a part-time community-access coordinator shared with programming, expanding the oral-histo
